scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Although I need help with a task, you are not strong enough to assist me, noob~!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
雖然我有任務需要幫忙，但你太弱了，幫不上忙，菜鳥~！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Come back later when you have done some training and are at least level 120!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
等你訓練好，至少達到120級後再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I can only open the secret passage for party leaders. Please have your party leader talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
我只能為隊伍首領開啟秘密通道。請讓你的隊伍首領來和我說話。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Have you found the princess yet?! Is she safe?
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
你找到公主了嗎？！她安全嗎？

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
The monsters around the secret passage have disappeared. Now is our chance to save the princess!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
秘密通道周圍的魔物已經消失了。現在是拯救公主的機會！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I need help, even from the likes of you.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
我需要幫助，即使是像你這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
In the middle of battle the princess disappeared while I was guarding the palace.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
戰鬥正酣時，我在守衛皇宮，公主卻失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
You run ahead and I will catch up. We must save her.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
你先跑在前面，我會趕上的。我們必須救她。

scripts.text: I will help.
scripts.translation: 我會幫忙。

scripts.text: This is not a good time.
scripts.translation: 現在不是時候。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Even now all the royal guards are fighting and dying from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
即使現在，所有的皇家衛士都在與魔物戰鬥並犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
We must, no matter how much fear grips our hearts, save the princess!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
無論心中多麼恐懼，我們都必須拯救公主！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Thank you..
I will open the secret passage to the ^0000ffGhost Palace^000000.
Please be ready!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
謝謝你...
我將開啟通往^0000ff幽靈皇宮^000000的秘密通道。
請做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Althought I need help with a task, you are not strong enough to assist me, noob~!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
雖然我有任務需要幫忙，但你太弱了，幫不上忙，菜鳥~！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Come back later when you have done some training and are at least level 120!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
等你訓練好，至少達到120級後再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I can see the secret passage into the palace. Are you ready to save the princess?!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
我能看到通往皇宮的秘密通道。你準備好拯救公主了嗎？！

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Even now all the royal guards are fighting and dying from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
即使現在，所有的皇家衛士都在與魔物戰鬥並犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
We must, no matter how much fear grips our hearts, save the princess!
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
無論心中多麼恐懼，我們都必須拯救公主！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
The monsters that attacked the palace are wandering around the secret entrance. It would be very bad if they spotted us... Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
攻擊皇宮的魔物在秘密入口附近徘徊。如果它們發現我們就糟了...請等一下。

scripts.text:
When the time limit for the entrance is up
let's try to re-enter.
scripts.translation:
當入口的時間限制結束時
讓我們嘗試重新進入。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe time limit for entering to the Curse of the Swordsman is finished. Please try to talk to the Unpleasent Royal Guard again..^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff進入劍士詛咒的時間限制已結束。請再次與不悅的皇家衛士交談。^000000

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I can only open the secret passage for party leaders. Please have your party leader talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[不悅的皇家衛士]
我只能為隊伍首領開啟秘密通道。請讓你的隊伍首領來和我說話。

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生了一個未知錯誤。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Inside the devices you see a dark hole. If you wish to enter you must to talk to the Unpleasent Royal Guard first.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在裝置內部，你看到一個黑暗的空洞。如果你想進入，必須先與不悅的皇家衛士交談。^000000

scripts.text: Only registered members can enter the {0} instance.
scripts.translation: 只有註冊成員才能進入{0}副本。

scripts.text:
[King]
You are hereby appointed as the personal guard to Princess Tiara. I trust your loyalty above all else.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
我在此任命你為蒂亞拉公主的貼身護衛。我信任你的忠誠勝過一切。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
I will protect the princess with my life.
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
我願以性命守護公主。

scripts.text:
[King]
The marriage arrangements are going as planned. The prince is here to meet with the princess.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
婚事正按計劃進行。王子已抵達，準備與公主會面。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
...Yes, Your Majesty.
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
...遵命，陛下。

scripts.text:
[King]
My gods, there are monsters in the castle! Get rid of them now!
scripts.translation:
[國王]
天哪，城堡裡有魔物！立刻消滅它們！

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Your Highness, the King has invited a prince from a neighboring country to be your betrothed. Be ready to meet him...
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
殿下，國王陛下邀請了鄰國的王子作為您的未婚夫。請做好見面的準備...

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
If...If a marriage is arranged what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主]
如...如果婚事已經安排好了，我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
The only thing I can do is protect you from physical harm.
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
我能做的，只有保護您免受身體上的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Then, what can I do?
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主]
那麼，我能做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
You must decide that for yourself Your Highness...
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
殿下，這件事必須由您自己決定...

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Would it be easier for you if I were married and sent off to another country?
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主]
如果我嫁出去，被送往他國，對你來說會輕鬆一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
I will always stand by you and protect you forever.
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
我會永遠陪伴在您身邊，守護您。

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Monsters have gotten inside the castle? Please, protect me!
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主]
魔物闖進城堡了？請保護我！

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Stay behind me. Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
躲在我身後。我們走！

scripts.text:
[King]
It was you who brought the monsters here! You want to get rid of me and have the princess for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[國王]
是你把魔物引來的！你想除掉我，獨佔公主嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
It is a trap Your Majesty! You must trust me!
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
陛下，這是個陷阱！請相信我！

scripts.text:
[King]
Shut up! You've betrayed me! I trusted you... you must pay for your disgrace.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
閉嘴！你背叛了我！我曾信任你...你必須為你的恥辱付出代價。

scripts.text:
[King]
You will suffer for the rest of your life.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
你將餘生都在痛苦中度過。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Where is Princess Tiara?
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
蒂亞拉公主在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Visiting Prince]
You are too late... but you brought what I was looking for. Thanks for your help.
scripts.translation:
[來訪的王子]
你來得太晚了...不過你帶來了我在找的東西。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Visiting Prince]
Cursed Magic Sword Tartanos! Are you ready to have a new master?
scripts.translation:
[來訪的王子]
被詛咒的魔劍 塔爾塔諾斯！你準備好迎接新的主人了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magic Sword Tartanos]
How dare you!
scripts.translation:
[魔劍 塔爾塔諾斯]
你竟敢如此！

scripts.text:
[Visiting Prince]
aah, aah !!!
scripts.translation:
[來訪的王子]
啊...啊啊！！

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
You kept your promise.
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主]
你遵守了諾言。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
princess!
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
公主！

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Thank you... now I can rest beside you...
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主]
謝謝你...現在我可以安息在你身邊了...

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
No..No!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
不...不！！！！

scripts.text:
[The voice of Princess Tiara]
I want to be with you forever in peace...forever...
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主的聲音]
我想永遠和你在一起...永遠...在寧靜中...

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
no.....Ahh ahh ahh!!!!~!
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
不.....啊 啊 啊！！！！~！

scripts.text:
[The voice of Princess Tiara]
I love you...
scripts.translation:
[蒂亞拉公主的聲音]
我愛你...

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Are you satisfied..? Magic Sword Tartanos?
scripts.translation:
[陰沉的皇家衛士]
你滿意了嗎..？魔劍 塔爾塔諾斯？

scripts.text:
[Magic Sword Tartanos]
I need more blood..Sakray, offer me his blood.
scripts.translation:
[魔劍 塔爾塔諾斯]
我需要更多的鮮血..薩克雷，把他的血獻給我。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Okay, that is good. A traveller. Did you see?
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
很好，就是這樣。一個旅行者。你看到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sakray, what do you want? Sympathy? Or is it a trap?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
薩克雷，你想要什麼？同情？還是這是個陷阱？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
No... I do not need to make any effort to catch a novice.
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
不...我不需要費力氣去抓一個初心者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If so... then why...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果是這樣...那麼為什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
I wanted to get rid of a piece of humanity inside of me through you.
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
我想通過你，擺脫我內心殘存的人性。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
I am quite satisfied with the result.
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
我對結果相當滿意。

scripts.text:
[Magic Sword Tartanos]
Sakray, offer the blood to me now!
scripts.translation:
[魔劍 塔爾塔諾斯]
薩克雷，現在就把血獻給我！

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
If you were me, what would you do?
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
如果你是我，你會怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Can you set yourself free from this curse?
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
你能擺脫這個詛咒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Heh heh... I will keep watching you until the day comes when you are old enough.
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
呵呵呵...我會一直注視著你，直到你長大成人。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
I am willing to hunt you later for Tartanos.
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
為了塔爾塔諾斯，我日後會獵殺你的。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Farewell then.
scripts.translation:
[薩克雷]
那麼，再見了。

scripts.text:
[King]
Hey there, are you alive?
I did not expect to meet someone who is still alive.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
嘿，你活著嗎？
沒想到還能遇到活人。

scripts.text:
[King]
Do you possibly have the ^006400{0}^000000?
Can you give it to me?
The memories of the faithful royal guard
and the memories of everyone he loved
are contained inside of these shards.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
你身上有^006400{0}^000000嗎？
能給我嗎？
忠誠的皇家衛士的記憶，
以及他深愛的所有人的記憶，
都蘊含在這些碎片之中。

scripts.text:
[King]
Will you give the ^006400{0}^000000 to me?
The guilt is eating my soul.
My soul is trapped inside the Ghost Palace.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
你願意把^006400{0}^000000給我嗎？
愧疚正在吞噬我的靈魂。
我的靈魂被困在幽靈皇宮裡。

scripts.text:
[King]
I am collecting Sakray's abandoned memories from these shards.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
我正在從這些碎片中收集薩克雷遺失的記憶。

scripts.text:
[King]
If you give any ^006400{0}^000000s to me, I can make equipment for you.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
如果你給我^006400{0}^000000，我可以為你製作裝備。

scripts.text:
[King]
The cursed knight...
Please help me save the soul of Sakray.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
被詛咒的騎士...
請幫幫我，拯救薩克雷的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[King]
Someday, Sakray will
get out of this curse for sure.
I believe
^006400{0}^000000s are the only method
to save him....
scripts.translation:
[國王]
總有一天，薩克雷一定能擺脫這個詛咒。
我相信
^006400{0}^000000是拯救他的唯一方法....

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Hand over {0} {1}.

[King]
Someday, Sakray will
get out of this curse for sure.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
總有一天，薩克雷一定能擺脫這個詛咒。

scripts.text: You see a light through the folded hands of the king and it gradually takes on a shape.
scripts.translation: 你看到國王合十的雙手間透出一縷光芒，它逐漸凝聚成形。

scripts.text:
[King]
All right, it is done.
Take this ^FF0000{0}^000000
to confront Sakray and Tartanos.
scripts.translation:
[國王]
好了，完成了。
拿著這把^FF0000{0}^000000，
去直面薩克雷和塔爾塔諾斯吧。

scripts.text:
[King]
The power requires a sacrifice.
Please be careful...
scripts.translation:
[國王]
這股力量需要犧牲。
請小心...

scripts.text:
It is time to leave the Ghost Palace.
Everything is now complete
and will vanish..
scripts.translation:
是時候離開幽靈皇宮了。
一切既已完成，
也將隨之消散..
